L16: As this function returns a 【11†borrowed reference】, the dictionary returned for 【12†optimized scopes】 is cached on the frame object and will remain alive as long as the frame object does. Unlike 【6†`PyEval_GetFrameLocals()`】 and 【7†`locals()`】, subsequent calls to this function in the same frame will update the contents of the cached dictionary to reflect changes in the state of the local variables rather than returning a new snapshot.
